categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Updates the src/ipc/libmultiprocess subtree, fixing concurrency issues, expanding type serialization, and adding non-Unix platform support.
categories.rationale: Fixes critical IPC concurrency bugs including a disconnect data race found by Antithesis and a socket use-after-free, while adding non-Unix support and unblocking seven downstream multiprocess PRs. The update directly resolves lifetime and stability issues in IPC disconnect handling ('Fixes a data race between IPC calls running on worker threads and disconnects' and 'Fixes a use-after-free when a socket disconnects before ConnectStream connects').
